title: 01_company_overview.md
text:
Northwind Analytics — Company Overview

Northwind Analytics, Inc. is a business-to-business software company that
provides a cloud analytics platform called InsightHub. The company was founded
in 2014 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with additional offices in
Dublin, Ireland and Singapore. As of 2025 Northwind employs approximately 600
people across engineering, sales, customer success, and operations.

title: 01_company_overview.md
text:
The chief executive officer is Dana Whitfield, who co-founded the company. The
chief technology officer is Marcus Lee, and the chief information security
officer (CISO) is Priya Nair. The company is privately held and backed by
venture investors, having raised a Series C round of 80 million US dollars in
2022.

Mission

Northwind's mission is to help mid-market and enterprise customers turn raw
operational data into decisions in minutes rather than weeks. The product is
sold primarily through an annual subscription model with three tiers: Starter,
Growth, and Enterprise.

Business facts

title: 01_company_overview.md
text:
- Fiscal year runs from February 1 to January 31.
- The company serves more than 2,000 paying customers in 40 countries.
- Annual recurring revenue crossed 120 million US dollars in fiscal year 2025.
- The primary cloud provider is Amazon Web Services, with data residency options
  in the United States, the European Union (Frankfurt), and Singapore.

For questions about corporate matters, contact the operations team at
ops@northwind.example. Press inquiries go to press@northwind.example.

title: 02_data_retention_policy.md
text:
Data Retention Policy

This policy defines how long Northwind Analytics retains different categories of
data and when that data is deleted. It applies to all customer data, personal
data, and internal records processed by the InsightHub platform and corporate
systems.

Retention periods

title: 02_data_retention_policy.md
text:
- **Customer account data**: retained for the life of the subscription and for
  24 months after account closure, after which it is permanently deleted.
- **Personal data of end users**: retained for 24 months after the associated
  account is closed, unless a longer period is required by law.
- **Biometric data**: Northwind does not use biometric data for its core
  product. Where a customer explicitly enables an optional biometric
  authentication feature, biometric templates are retained for a maximum of 12
  months and are deleted within 30 days of feature deactivation.
- **Application and audit logs**: retained for 13 months to support security
  investigations, then rotated out of storage.
- **Financial and tax records**: retained for 7 years to meet regulatory
  obligations.
- **Backups**: encrypted backups are retained for 35 days on a rolling basis.

title: 02_data_retention_policy.md
text:
Data subject rights

Under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Northwind fulfills data
subject access, correction, and erasure requests within 30 days. Under the
California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), verifiable consumer requests are
fulfilled within 45 days, extendable once by an additional 45 days when
reasonably necessary.

Erasure requests are honored across primary storage within 30 days and are
purged from backups on the next backup rotation cycle. To submit a request,
contact the data protection officer at dpo@northwind.example.

title: 03_privacy_data_protection_policy.md
text:
Privacy and Data Protection Policy

Northwind Analytics processes personal data as both a data controller (for its
own employees and website visitors) and a data processor (on behalf of customers
who use InsightHub). This policy describes the safeguards that apply.

Legal bases and roles

For customer data processed through InsightHub, the customer is the data
controller and Northwind is the data processor. Processing is governed by a Data
Processing Agreement (DPA) that is incorporated into every Enterprise contract.
The DPA includes the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses for
international data transfers.

Data protection officer

title: 03_privacy_data_protection_policy.md
text:
Northwind has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) who oversees compliance
with GDPR, CCPA, and other applicable privacy laws. The DPO can be reached at
dpo@northwind.example and reports directly to the General Counsel.

Key commitments

title: 03_privacy_data_protection_policy.md
text:
- Personal data is processed only for documented, legitimate purposes.
- Data minimization is applied: only the fields required for a feature are
  collected.
- Cross-border transfers rely on Standard Contractual Clauses or an adequacy
  decision.
- Sub-processors are listed publicly and customers are notified at least 30 days
  before a new sub-processor is added.
- Data breaches affecting personal data are reported to the relevant supervisory
  authority within 72 hours, consistent with GDPR Article 33.

Cookies and website

title: 03_privacy_data_protection_policy.md
text:
The corporate website uses only strictly necessary cookies by default.
Analytics cookies are loaded only after the visitor gives consent through the
cookie banner. Consent choices are stored for 12 months.

title: 04_information_security_policy.md
text:
Information Security Policy

Northwind Analytics maintains an information security program aligned with ISO
27001 and is audited annually against the SOC 2 Type II framework. The program
is owned by the Chief Information Security Officer, Priya Nair.

Encryption

- All customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256.
- All data in transit is encrypted using TLS version 1.2 or higher.
- Encryption keys are managed in AWS Key Management Service and rotated
  automatically every 12 months.

Authentication

title: 04_information_security_policy.md
text:
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for all employee accounts and
  for all administrative access to production systems.
- Employee passwords must be at least 14 characters and are rotated every 90
  days.
- Single sign-on (SSO) via SAML is available to all Enterprise customers.

Endpoint and network security

- Company laptops use full-disk encryption and centrally managed anti-malware.
- Production environments are isolated in a separate AWS account with no direct
  internet ingress except through a hardened load balancer.
- Vulnerability scans run weekly, and critical vulnerabilities are remediated
  within 7 days.

Certifications

title: 04_information_security_policy.md
text:
Northwind holds SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications. Copies of the
current SOC 2 report are available to customers under NDA by request to
security@northwind.example. Penetration tests are conducted by an independent
third party at least once per year.

title: 05_acceptable_use_policy.md
text:
Acceptable Use Policy

This Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) governs how employees and contractors may use
Northwind Analytics systems, networks, and the InsightHub platform.

Permitted use

Company systems are provided for legitimate business purposes. Incidental
personal use is permitted so long as it does not interfere with work, consume
significant resources, or violate any policy.

Prohibited activities

title: 05_acceptable_use_policy.md
text:
- Sharing account credentials or bypassing multi-factor authentication.
- Installing unapproved software on company laptops.
- Accessing customer data without a documented business need (the principle of
  least privilege applies at all times).
- Disabling security controls such as disk encryption or anti-malware.
- Using company resources to send spam, harass others, or infringe copyright.

Data handling

Confidential and customer data must never be copied to personal devices,
personal cloud storage, or removable media. Data classified as Restricted may
only be accessed from managed devices on approved networks.

Enforcement

title: 05_acceptable_use_policy.md
text:
Violations of this policy may result in disciplinary action up to and including
termination, and may be reported to law enforcement where illegal activity is
involved. Questions about acceptable use should be directed to the IT service
desk at ithelp@northwind.example.

title: 06_access_control_iam_policy.md
text:
Access Control and Identity Management Policy

Northwind Analytics enforces the principle of least privilege: every person and
system is granted the minimum access required to perform their role.

Provisioning and roles

Access is granted based on role. New employees receive a baseline set of
application access during onboarding. Any access to production customer data
requires manager approval and a documented business justification, and is
granted through time-limited, role-based entitlements.

Reviews

title: 06_access_control_iam_policy.md
text:
- User access rights are reviewed every quarter by system owners.
- Privileged (administrator) accounts are reviewed monthly.
- Service accounts must have a named owner and are reviewed twice a year.

Offboarding

When an employee or contractor leaves, all access is revoked within 24 hours of
their departure. For involuntary terminations, access is revoked immediately,
before or at the time of notification.

Privileged access

title: 06_access_control_iam_policy.md
text:
Administrative access to production systems requires multi-factor authentication
and is performed through a bastion host that records session logs. Standing
administrative access is discouraged; just-in-time elevation is preferred and
expires automatically after 4 hours. All privileged sessions are logged and
retained for 13 months.

Questions about access requests should go to the IT service desk at
ithelp@northwind.example.

title: 07_incident_response_runbook.md
text:
Incident Response Runbook

This runbook describes how Northwind Analytics detects, classifies, and responds
to security and availability incidents.

Severity levels

- **SEV1 — Critical**: customer-facing outage or confirmed data breach. Initial
  response within 15 minutes; target resolution within 4 hours.
- **SEV2 — High**: major feature degraded for many customers. Initial response
  within 30 minutes; target resolution within 8 hours.
- **SEV3 — Moderate**: limited impact or workaround available. Response within 4
  business hours.
- **SEV4 — Low**: minor issue, no customer impact. Handled in the normal backlog.

Roles

title: 07_incident_response_runbook.md
text:
Every incident has an Incident Commander who coordinates the response, a
Communications Lead who handles customer and internal updates, and one or more
Responders. The on-call rotation is managed in PagerDuty and covers 24 hours a
day, 7 days a week.

Process

1. Detect and declare the incident, assigning a severity.
2. Assemble the response team in the incident channel.
3. Contain, then eradicate the root cause.
4. Recover services and confirm normal operation.
5. Within 5 business days, publish a blameless post-incident review.

Breach notification

title: 07_incident_response_runbook.md
text:
If personal data is confirmed to be affected, the Data Protection Officer is
engaged immediately and affected supervisory authorities are notified within 72
hours, consistent with the privacy policy. Customers are notified without undue
delay. Report suspected incidents to security@northwind.example.

title: 08_business_continuity_dr.md
text:
Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery

Northwind Analytics maintains a business continuity plan (BCP) and disaster
recovery (DR) plan to ensure InsightHub remains available and customer data is
protected against loss.

Recovery objectives

- **Recovery Time Objective (RTO): 4 hours.** In a disaster, core InsightHub
  services are restored within 4 hours.
- **Recovery Point Objective (RPO): 1 hour.** No more than 1 hour of data is at
  risk of loss.

Backups

title: 08_business_continuity_dr.md
text:
Customer data is backed up daily. Backups are encrypted with AES-256 and stored
in a separate AWS region from the primary environment. Backups are retained on a
rolling 35-day basis. Restore procedures are tested at least once per quarter,
and the results are documented.

Redundancy

Production runs across multiple AWS Availability Zones. The database uses
synchronous replication within the primary region and asynchronous replication
to a secondary region for regional failover.

Testing and review

title: 08_business_continuity_dr.md
text:
The full DR plan is tested at least once per year through a simulated regional
failover. The BCP is reviewed annually and after any SEV1 incident. Plan
ownership sits with the VP of Engineering, and questions can be sent to
ops@northwind.example.

title: 09_vendor_procurement_policy.md
text:
Vendor and Procurement Policy

This policy governs how Northwind Analytics selects, approves, and manages
third-party vendors, with particular attention to vendors that handle customer
or personal data.

Security review

Any vendor that will store, process, or access Northwind customer data must pass
a security review before a contract is signed. The review covers the vendor's
certifications (such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001), data handling practices, and
sub-processor list. Vendors handling personal data must sign a Data Processing
Agreement (DPA).

Approval thresholds

title: 09_vendor_procurement_policy.md
text:
- Purchases under 5,000 US dollars per year require manager approval.
- Purchases between 5,000 and 50,000 US dollars require director approval and a
  security review if data is involved.
- Purchases over 50,000 US dollars require VP approval and a formal procurement
  process with at least two competing bids.

Ongoing management

Critical vendors are re-assessed annually. A vendor register is maintained by
the procurement team, recording the owner, contract renewal date, and data
classification handled. Vendors that fail a re-assessment are placed on a
remediation plan or offboarded.

Contacts

title: 09_vendor_procurement_policy.md
text:
Procurement requests are submitted through the finance portal. Questions go to
procurement@northwind.example, and security reviews are coordinated with
security@northwind.example.

title: 10_employee_onboarding_guide.md
text:
Employee Onboarding Guide

Welcome to Northwind Analytics. This guide summarizes what new employees can
expect during their first 90 days.

Before day one

The IT team ships a company laptop so it arrives before the start date. Laptops
come with full-disk encryption, single sign-on, and required software
pre-installed. Accounts are provisioned with baseline access based on the new
hire's role.

First week

- Complete security awareness and privacy training (required within the first 5
  business days).
- Set up multi-factor authentication on all accounts.
- Meet with your manager to review the 30-60-90 day plan.
- Be assigned an onboarding buddy from your team.

First 90 days

title: 10_employee_onboarding_guide.md
text:
New employees follow a structured ramp with clear milestones at 30, 60, and 90
days. Engineers ship their first small change to production within the first two
weeks, supported by a mentor and code review.

Required training

All employees must complete security awareness training within 5 business days
and annually thereafter. Employees who handle customer data complete additional
privacy training covering GDPR and CCPA obligations.

Getting help

The IT service desk (ithelp@northwind.example) helps with equipment and access.
People-team questions go to hr@northwind.example.

title: 11_pto_leave_policy.md
text:
Paid Time Off and Leave Policy

Northwind Analytics offers a competitive time-off program to full-time
employees. This policy summarizes vacation, holidays, sick leave, and parental
leave.

Vacation

Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid vacation per year. Up to 5 unused
vacation days may be carried over into the next calendar year; days beyond that
are forfeited. Vacation requests should be submitted at least 2 weeks in advance
through the HR portal.

Company holidays

Northwind observes 10 paid company holidays each year, published in advance for
each region. Employees in Dublin and Singapore follow their local public holiday
calendars.

Sick leave

title: 11_pto_leave_policy.md
text:
Employees receive 10 paid sick days per year. Sick leave does not carry over.
For absences longer than 3 consecutive days, a doctor's note may be requested.

Parental leave

Northwind provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary
caregiver and 8 weeks for the secondary caregiver, available to all full-time
employees regardless of gender, following 6 months of employment.

Bereavement and jury duty

Up to 5 days of paid bereavement leave is available for an immediate family
member. Jury duty is paid in full for the duration of service. Questions about
leave go to hr@northwind.example.

title: 12_remote_work_policy.md
text:
Remote and Hybrid Work Policy

Northwind Analytics operates a hybrid work model that balances flexibility with
in-person collaboration.

In-office expectations

Employees who live within 50 kilometers of a Northwind office are expected to
work from the office at least 2 days per week. Fully remote roles are available
for certain positions and are designated at the time of hiring.

Equipment and stipend

Northwind provides a company laptop to every employee. Remote and hybrid
employees receive a one-time home-office stipend of 500 US dollars and a monthly
internet reimbursement of 50 US dollars.

Security requirements

title: 12_remote_work_policy.md
text:
Remote work must be performed on a company-managed device. Employees must use
the company VPN when accessing internal systems from untrusted networks, keep
full-disk encryption enabled, and never allow family members to use company
devices. Access to data classified as Restricted is only permitted from managed
devices on approved networks.

Working across regions

Employees who wish to work from a location outside their home country for more
than 30 days per year must obtain approval from HR because of tax and compliance
implications. Questions go to hr@northwind.example.

title: 13_expense_reimbursement_policy.md
text:
Expense Reimbursement Policy

This policy explains how employees submit business expenses and how quickly they
are reimbursed.

General rules

- Expenses must be reasonable, business-related, and submitted within 30 days.
- Receipts are required for any expense over 25 US dollars.
- Approved reimbursements are paid within 14 days of approval, in the next
  payroll cycle.

Travel

title: 13_expense_reimbursement_policy.md
text:
- Air travel should be booked in economy class for flights under 6 hours;
  premium economy is permitted for flights of 6 hours or more.
- Hotel stays are reimbursed up to 250 US dollars per night in standard cities
  and up to 350 US dollars per night in high-cost cities.
- Ground transportation and standard ride-share services are reimbursable.

Meals

Daily meals while traveling are reimbursed up to 75 US dollars per day.
Alcohol is not reimbursable except at pre-approved client entertainment events.

Approvals

title: 13_expense_reimbursement_policy.md
text:
Expenses under 1,000 US dollars are approved by the employee's manager. Expenses
of 1,000 US dollars or more require director approval. Fraudulent expense claims
are grounds for termination. Submit expenses through the finance portal;
questions go to finance@northwind.example.

title: 14_benefits_compensation.md
text:
Benefits and Compensation Overview

Northwind Analytics offers a comprehensive benefits package to full-time
employees, effective on the first day of employment.

Health and insurance

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance, with Northwind covering 90 percent of
  the premium for employees and 75 percent for dependents.
- Company-paid life insurance equal to one year of base salary.
- Employee assistance program offering confidential counseling.

Retirement

title: 14_benefits_compensation.md
text:
Northwind offers a 401(k) plan for US employees with a company match of 100
percent of the first 4 percent of salary contributed. Employees are fully vested
in the match immediately. Employees in Ireland and Singapore receive equivalent
locally compliant retirement contributions.

Equity

Most full-time employees receive stock options as part of their offer. Options
vest over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, meaning 25 percent vests after the first
year and the remainder vests monthly thereafter.

Learning and wellness

title: 14_benefits_compensation.md
text:
Every employee receives an annual professional development budget of 1,500 US
dollars for courses, conferences, and books. A monthly wellness stipend of 50 US
dollars can be used for gym memberships or fitness apps.

Reviews

Compensation is reviewed once per year during the annual review cycle. Questions
about benefits go to hr@northwind.example.

title: 15_performance_review_process.md
text:
Performance Review Process

Northwind Analytics runs a structured performance review process to give
employees clear, fair, and regular feedback.

Cadence

Formal performance reviews happen twice per year: a mid-year review in July and
a year-end review in January. Informal check-ins between managers and their
reports are expected at least every two weeks.

Rating scale

Employees are rated on a 5-point scale:

1. Below expectations
2. Partially meets expectations
3. Meets expectations
4. Exceeds expectations
5. Outstanding

Calibration

title: 15_performance_review_process.md
text:
To ensure consistency and fairness, managers participate in a calibration
session where ratings across teams are reviewed together before they are
finalized. This reduces individual manager bias.

Promotions and compensation

Promotion decisions and annual compensation adjustments are made during the
year-end cycle and take effect on March 1. A promotion requires a demonstrated
track record at the next level and manager plus skip-level approval.

Performance improvement

Employees rated Below expectations are placed on a performance improvement plan
(PIP) with clear goals over a defined period, typically 60 days. Questions about
the process go to hr@northwind.example.

title: 16_code_of_conduct.md
text:
Code of Conduct

Northwind Analytics is committed to a respectful, inclusive, and ethical
workplace. This code applies to all employees, contractors, and anyone acting on
the company's behalf.

Core expectations

- Treat colleagues, customers, and partners with respect and professionalism.
- Do not engage in harassment, discrimination, or bullying of any kind.
- Avoid conflicts of interest, and disclose any that arise to your manager.
- Protect confidential and customer information at all times.

Anti-bribery and gifts

title: 16_code_of_conduct.md
text:
Employees may not offer or accept bribes or kickbacks. Business gifts must be
modest; any gift valued over 100 US dollars must be declared to the compliance
team. Facilitation payments are prohibited.

Diversity and inclusion

Northwind is an equal-opportunity employer. Hiring, promotion, and compensation
decisions are based on merit and never on race, gender, age, religion, disability,
sexual orientation, or other protected characteristics.

Reporting concerns

title: 16_code_of_conduct.md
text:
Employees can report suspected violations to their manager, to HR, or
anonymously through the ethics hotline. Northwind prohibits retaliation against
anyone who raises a concern in good faith. Reports can be sent to
ethics@northwind.example.

title: 17_product_insighthub_overview.md
text:
InsightHub Product Overview

InsightHub is Northwind Analytics' flagship cloud analytics platform. It lets
teams connect data sources, build dashboards, and set up automated alerts
without writing code.

Core capabilities

- **Connectors**: over 120 pre-built connectors to databases, warehouses, and
  SaaS applications such as Salesforce, Snowflake, and PostgreSQL.
- **Dashboards**: drag-and-drop dashboards with real-time refresh.
- **Alerts**: threshold and anomaly-based alerts delivered by email, Slack, or
  webhook.
- **Governance**: row-level security, audit logs, and role-based access control.

Subscription tiers

title: 17_product_insighthub_overview.md
text:
- **Starter**: up to 5 users, 10 data sources, community support.
- **Growth**: up to 50 users, 50 data sources, email support, SSO available.
- **Enterprise**: unlimited users, unlimited data sources, 99.9 percent uptime
  service level agreement, dedicated customer success manager, and a signed Data
  Processing Agreement.

Data residency

Enterprise customers can choose to have their data stored in the United States,
the European Union (Frankfurt), or Singapore. Data does not leave the selected
region except as required to deliver the service and as described in the DPA.

Availability

title: 17_product_insighthub_overview.md
text:
InsightHub targets 99.9 percent monthly uptime for Enterprise customers. Status
and historical uptime are published at status.northwind.example.

title: 18_api_authentication_guide.md
text:
InsightHub API Authentication Guide

The InsightHub REST API lets developers programmatically manage data sources,
dashboards, and alerts. This guide explains how to authenticate.

Authentication methods

InsightHub supports two authentication methods:

1. **OAuth 2.0** for user-facing integrations, using the authorization code
   flow.
2. **API keys** for server-to-server automation.

Tokens

OAuth access tokens expire after 1 hour. A refresh token, valid for 30 days, can
be used to obtain a new access token without the user signing in again. If a
refresh token is unused for 30 days it is revoked automatically.

API keys

title: 18_api_authentication_guide.md
text:
API keys are created in the InsightHub admin console under Settings then API
Keys. A key is shown only once at creation time and must be stored securely. Keys
can be scoped to specific permissions (read-only or read-write) and can be
revoked at any time.

Rate limits

The API allows 600 requests per minute per API key. Requests beyond the limit
receive an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header. Enterprise customers can
request a higher limit.

Security

All API traffic must use HTTPS. Requests over plain HTTP are rejected. Never
embed API keys in client-side code. For help, contact
developers@northwind.example.

title: 19_engineering_deployment_runbook.md
text:
Engineering Deployment Runbook

This runbook describes how Northwind Analytics ships changes to the InsightHub
production environment.

Continuous delivery

Changes are merged to the main branch only after passing automated tests and at
least one peer code review. Every merge triggers a continuous integration
pipeline that builds artifacts and runs the full test suite.

Deployment strategy

Northwind uses blue-green deployments. A new version is deployed to an idle
(green) environment, smoke-tested, and then traffic is switched over from the
current (blue) environment. If a problem is detected, traffic is switched back
instantly, providing a fast rollback.

Deployment windows

title: 19_engineering_deployment_runbook.md
text:
Routine deployments happen during business hours, Monday through Thursday.
Deployments are frozen on Fridays and during any active SEV1 incident. Emergency
fixes may be deployed at any time with approval from the on-call Incident
Commander.

Database changes

Schema migrations must be backward compatible so that the old and new versions
can run simultaneously during a blue-green switch. Destructive migrations, such
as dropping a column, are split across at least two releases.

Observability

title: 19_engineering_deployment_runbook.md
text:
Every service emits metrics, logs, and traces. Deployments are monitored for 30
minutes after release, and an automated rollback triggers if error rates exceed
the defined threshold. Questions go to platform@northwind.example.

title: 20_customer_support_sla.md
text:
Customer Support and Service Level Agreement

Northwind Analytics provides tiered customer support with response-time
commitments that depend on the subscription tier and the severity of the issue.

Support channels

- **Starter**: community forum and email support.
- **Growth**: email support during business hours.
- **Enterprise**: 24/7 support by email and phone, plus a dedicated customer
  success manager.

Response-time targets (Enterprise)

title: 20_customer_support_sla.md
text:
- **Critical** (production down): first response within 1 hour.
- **High** (major feature impaired): first response within 4 hours.
- **Normal** (general issue): first response within 1 business day.
- **Low** (question or feature request): first response within 2 business days.

Uptime service level agreement

For Enterprise customers, InsightHub commits to 99.9 percent monthly uptime. If
uptime falls below this level, affected customers are eligible for service
credits: 10 percent of the monthly fee for uptime between 99.0 and 99.9 percent,
and 25 percent for uptime below 99.0 percent.

Escalation

title: 20_customer_support_sla.md
text:
Customers can escalate an unresolved critical issue by replying to the support
ticket with the word ESCALATE, which pages the on-call manager. Support can be
reached at support@northwind.example.
